title: Quantyra optical fixture system
description: Keyed light-source stand and cradle for the unchanged dual V11 photodiode jig, with preserved legacy stands, cradle and lift-off hood. Editable OpenSCAD, exact STL meshes and documentation under CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
